benefits.title: Not a card.
benefits.explain: Banks are starting to give those away. You're buying control, time and proof.

control.title: Nothing goes out without your approval.
control.text: Budgets, limits, allowed merchants, guardrails against prompt injection. Above your thresholds, every expense waits for your passkey signature, from one or more approvers.

time.title: No more cards created by hand.
time.text: The agent asks, you sign with a single tap, the card is created in your bank, the transaction is reconciled and the invoice filed. No more statements to tick off or receipts to chase.

proof.title: A human approved every expense.
proof.text: Signed mandates, a chained, tamper-proof audit log and a quarterly oversight report: what the AI Act, your CFO and your auditor ask for, ready to hand over.

agencies.title: One budget and one invoice per client.
agencies.text: Client workspaces, a monthly budget per client, a re-invoicing margin and a monthly report ready to send. Your clients finally see what their agents spend.

how.title: Four steps, no shared card.
how.s1Text: Via MCP or the API: “{amount} at Notion, team subscription”.
how.s2Text: Budget, limit, merchant: outside the rules, the request is refused on the spot.
how.s3Text: A notification on your phone, a passkey signature.
how.s4Text: A single-use card, the exact amount, a short expiry, then automatic reconciliation.

useCases.title: What your agents already buy.
useCases.explain: Now with a card of their own.

api.title: APIs and tokens
api.text: Top up credits when the quota runs out, without leaving the company card in a .env file.

saas.title: SaaS subscriptions
saas.text: Subscribe to or extend a plan for the team, for the exact amount approved.

cloud.title: Cloud and domains
cloud.text: Buy a domain name or pay a hosting overage in the middle of a deployment.

data.title: Data and B2B purchases
data.text: Pay for a dataset, a scraping job or supplies, with the receipt attached automatically.
